args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. At the time of response, v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with an error rate of 0.18 and healthy=false. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is VERIFIED and all regions report v2.3.0. Release history: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy but only in staging. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but only in staging.
- **Before the rollback:** v2.3.1 was running in all regions with a 0.18 error rate and `healthy: false`.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api. It describes the failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer.

The incident notes that v2.3.1 needs investigation before it is released again.
